Everyday program.description: Start a program without GO_PARANOID or seal; outputs remain run-confined and hashed.

Paranoid program.description: Start a paranoid-mode program with one sealed value.

Assignment.description: Assign an expression to a name.

Print value.description: Print a named value using interpolation.

Formatted output.description: Print a numeric SI value with explicit precision.

Seal artifact.description: Preserve the current value as a run artifact.

For range loop.description: Half-open integer loop with a shared 1,000,000-iteration ceiling.

While loop.description: Boolean-condition loop with a shared iteration ceiling.

If, else if, else.description: Boolean conditions; only the selected branch executes.

Switch cases.description: First exact matching case; no fallthrough.

G funk function.description: Define a local-scope function with an explicit return.

Parse a checked number.description: Convert finite, unitless decimal text to a quantity; invalid text fails.

Split and join text.description: Split text into an array and join its text parts.

Ask for one line.description: Interactive text input; responses are preserved in the run evidence.

Program argument.description: Read a zero-based program argument after the -- separator.

Array and independent slice.description: Create an array and an independent half-open slice.

Append array item.description: Assign a new copy with one appended item.

FITS table mean.description: Read a numeric FITS binary-table column mean.

CSV result.description: Write a run-confined CSV result; GO_PARANOID is optional.
